db:insert.db:sql: insert into max.inquiries (inquiry_id, customer_id, channel, received_on, subject, body) select inquiry_id, customer_id, channel, received_on, subject, body from max.planned_inquiries where received_on = cast(:d as date) on conflict (inquiry_id) do nothing

db:select.db:sql: select inquiry_id from max.inquiries where received_on = cast(:d as date) and status = '受付' order by inquiry_id

set-variable.value: #['問い合わせ ' ++ payload ++ ' に返事して']

db:select.db:sql: select i.inquiry_id, to_char(i.received_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as received_on, i.customer_id, c.name as customer_name, i.channel, i.subject, i.status, i.sent_by from max.inquiries i join max.customers c using (customer_id) where (:status = '' or i.status = :status) order by i.inquiry_id

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- payload map {inquiryId: $.inquiry_id, receivedOn: $.received_on, customerId: $.customer_id, customerName: $.customer_name, channel: $.channel, subject: $.subject, status: $.status, sentBy: $.sent_by}]

db:select.db:sql: select i.inquiry_id, i.customer_id, c.name as customer_name, to_char(c.opened_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as opened_on, c.experience_years, c.risk_tolerance, i.channel, to_char(i.received_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as received_on, i.subject, i.body, i.status, i.reply, i.sent_by, to_char(i.sent_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as sent_on from max.inquiries i join max.customers c using (customer_id) where i.inquiry_id = :id
select faq_id, category, question, answer from max.faq order by faq_id
select alert_id from max.alerts where customer_id = :cid order by alert_id

select a.application_id, a.status from max.applications a join max.customers c on replace(a.name, ' ', '') = replace(c.name, ' ', '') and a.birth_date = c.birth_date where c.customer_id = :cid and a.status in ('確認待ち', '承認待ち', '否認', '追加確認') order by a.application_id

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- do { var q = vars.inq[0] --- {inquiryId: q.inquiry_id, receivedOn: q.received_on, channel: q.channel, subject: q.subject, body: q.body, status: q.status, customer: {customerId: q.customer_id, name: q.customer_name, openedOn: q.opened_on}, faq: max::support::topFaq(q.subject ++ ' ' ++ q.body, vars.faqs, 3), requiresApproval: vars.guard.requiresApproval, approvalReasons: vars.guard.reasons, reply: q.reply, sentBy: q.sent_by, sentOn: q.sent_on}}]

mcp:tool-listener.name: list-inquiries
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Lists customer inquiries: ID, received date, customer, channel, subject and status (受付 / 送信済み / 承認待ち / 差し戻し / 担当者対応). Give status to list only that status.

mcp:tool-listener.name: get-inquiry
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Returns one customer inquiry in a single call: the message, the customer, the three closest FAQ entries (use only their content for facts in the reply), and whether the firm's fixed rules require an employee's approval before replying (requiresApproval, approvalReasons). The ID looks like Q-0003; "0003" or "3" is accepted too. Returns {"found": false} when there is no such inquiry.

mcp:tool-listener.name: send-reply
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Sends the reply to the customer, or, when an employee must approve first, puts the draft in the approval inbox instead. Approval is required when the firm's fixed rules say so (the tool checks them itself) or when you set needsApproval to "true". Returns {"status": "sent"} or {"status": "approval_requested", "approvalId": ..., "reasons": [...]}, or "already_sent" / "already_pending" / "not_found" / "failed" with the reason.

db:select.db:sql: select approval_id from max.approvals where target_id = :id and status = '承認待ち'

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- vars.guard.reasons ++ (if ((vars.args.needsApproval default 'false') == 'true') ['エージェントが確認を求めた: ' ++ trim(vars.args.reasoning default '')] else [])]

when.expression: #[['送信済み', '差し戻し', '担当者対応'] contains vars.detail.status]

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- {status: 'failed', inquiryId: vars.inqId, reason: 'reply is empty'}]

db:update.db:sql: update max.inquiries set status = '送信済み', reply = :reply, sent_by = 'agent:max-support', sent_on = (select today from max.business_clock) where inquiry_id = :id

db:insert.db:sql: insert into max.audit_log (actor, action, target, detail) values ('agent:max-support', 'send-reply', :target, cast(:detail as jsonb))
